text: Threads @ramonhouses bio is Spanish-only (43 followers) while half the posts are English. Add one English line and keep the ramonhouses.com/insights link - profile visitors from the English posts currently see a bio they may not read.

Two schedule gaps: Sunday has a single ramonhouses post (10:00) and Wednesday has no RE Single. The RE Single bank already has 30 cards - adding RE Single ES on Wed 10:00 and an RE Quote on Sun 12:00 gives a 7-day daily presence with zero new content.

@ramongtzl.growthwealth has no Threads profile, so its 14 weekly book cards reach only IG + FB. Creating the Threads profile (2 minutes, from the IG account) and adding 'threads' to its rows lets the agent publish there with no other change.

LinkedIn only reaches the personal profile - the Ramon Gutierrez PREC company page still needs Community Management API approval (then linkedin_auth.py --company). Until then no post lands on the company page.

Every caption closes with the same CTA line and none asks a question. Comments are what push reach on IG and Threads - ending one post per day with a specific question (e.g. 'Which Langley neighbourhood would you visit three times?') is the cheapest reach lever available.
